messages:
laura: Quick sync  uploaded fresh benchmark artifacts and three visual directions. Need a sharp launch narrative for April: hero stat, one-sentence PLG headline, enterprise gating flow, and webinar timing.

ben: Looked great. For PLG hero use median(128) latency with a small cost delta badge. For enterprise callout, surface p95 and mention SLA-readiness. Use 'up to' language for cost claims.

tess: Visual recs: landing = hero metric + compact cost card; blog = latency CDF + cost-vs-latency scatter with highlighted recommended configs. Add methodology panel linking raw CSVs.

ricardo: For the scatter, annotate pareto frontier points and label quantization/batching flags. Engineers will love the interactivity if we can do a small toggle for sequence length.

anya: Lead capture: form fields = email, company, company_size_bucket, expected_monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case, private_deploy_interest (checkbox). If company_size_bucket >= 100 OR expected_monthly_tokens_bucket >= 20M OR private_deploy_interest=true -> tag Enterprise and route to AE Slack.

laura: Good. Also capture 'need_SLA' boolean and a free-text field 'inference_problem' for routing. We'll gate the whitepaper behind the form; offer raw CSVs after email confirm.

ben: Copy ideas: PLG headline = "Fast inference, predictable economics"; Enterprise headline = "Production-grade latency with predictable unit costs". CTAs: PLG = Try API, Enterprise = Request demo / Whitepaper.

tess: Accessibility note: use > 3:1 contrast for delta badges, colorblind-safe palette, and patterned fills on the scatter points that represent config families.

ricardo: Data transparency: include test harness details in the whitepaper: model versions, hardware, batch sizes, KV cache settings, quantization, and the random seed. Link code repo for reproducibility.

anya: HubSpot flow: I'll build form, set rules to create Contact + Company, add tags, and webhook Enterprise leads to AE queue. Also include UTM capture and events: bench_whitepaper_requested, webinar_registered, bench_try_clicked.

asset-bot: [system] uploaded /shared/marketing/bench/artifacts/bench-v4-visuals.zip by laura at 2026-03-22T17:02:12Z

laura: Webinar plan: 45min technical demo + 15min Q&A, title "Serving LLMs: practical tradeoffs between latency and cost". Schedule webinar 10 days after publish to let PLG traffic convert.

ben: Legal-friendly phrasing suggestion: "Up to 1.7x lower per-token cost on short chat sequences versus our internal baseline; see paper for details and caveats."

tess: I'll produce landing + blog comps with both hero variants. Expect drafts in 48 hours.

ricardo: If frontend wants an interactive slider widget, I'll provide annotated CSVs and a small JSON manifest. Need CORS and a light API endpoint.

anya: I'll set lead scoring rules and ensure Enterprise-fit triggers a high-priority workflow in HubSpot. Also add a boolean 'private_onprem' to route immediately.

laura: Final decisions: PLG hero = median(128), Enterprise hero = p95, gated whitepaper, webinar 10 days post-publish, and lead routing rules as above. We'll lock copy & visuals by next Tuesday. Thanks everyone.
